payload.title: A skill alone does not make an agent track work

payload.text: The first memory block hedged — "work may be tracked… before starting substantial work" — and runs came out inconsistent, because the model was judging whether the task was big enough and usually deciding it was not. Rewritten so the gate is the repo match, which is a fact, rather than the size of the work, which is an opinion.

payload.reason: Both halves ship. Trigger reliability went from roughly half to 3/3 across trials once the size judgment came out of the gate.
